Non-Travel Reimbursement

From the ORA eTraining module "Purchasing with Purpose: Procurement on Sponsored Projects" (lesson 13 of 15).
Non-Travel Reimbursements
A non-travel reimbursement is used when an employee pays for allowable, non-travel expenses out of pocket, such as project supplies, and needs to be reimbursed by the University. This process should be used only when the purchase is appropriate for reimbursement and allowable on the funding source. Original receipts of the costs outlined in the form should be included when submitting your request. For food related costs you must include a list of attendees for the event.
Complete the content above before moving on.
Non-Travel Reimbursement Form
Banner Requisition
A Banner requisition must be submitted for non-travel reimbursements. For this purpose, you will use the MSU ID of the employee to be reimbursed as the Vendor ID.
Employee Information
Enter the requested information for the employee that needs to be reimbursed.
Reason for Request
Provide details on (1) what was purchased and (2) why was it purchased outside of standard procurement methods such as the p-card or through requisition.
Department Administrator
Enter the details of the contact administrator submitting this reimbursement request.
Accounting
Enter the index funding the expense and the Banner account code
Reimbursement Cost
MSU is unable to reimburse tax charges. Do not include tax charges in your entered total cost.
DocuSign Signatures
It is best practice to submit this form via DocuSign. Create an envelope and ensure all listed approvers sign the request. Ensure the Comptroller is the final approver as their office will process the reimbursement.
